nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Suntouchable Invisible Sunscreen SPF 35

avis.texte: I like this small tube to take on vacation. It has a silky feel and I would compare it to the TJs dupe for SuperGoop. There is no smell and it glides on easily. I have used this before, and decided to repurchase since it was on sale. I would recommend this to others.

I love this product has great absorption into the skin leaving the finish looking great with no reapplication needed. There is no weird residue left behind on your face and makes it a great value for your buck!
This is the best face sunscreen! It's invisible and works all day. Just spend a week in Florida and was in the sun from 8-2 every day and didn't need to reapply.

This sunscreen did not work for me. The whole line was really irritating for my skin and wad unfortunately a miss. I had to discontinue use pretty immediately. It also smelled gross. I wouldn't recommend this, and would look to another brand instead.
I love how this feels on my face. It goes on smooth and it is not greasy. I will definitely buy this product again!
this sunscreen is soo good!! especially as someone who always gets white casts with sunscreen, this invisible one was a game changer! it has such a nice blurring effect too! x
Great product! Very lightweight and perfect size for my beach bag! I love skincare with spf, this is the perfect product to have both! I will definitely be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Lightweight, invisible SPF protection that feels comforta...
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with the e.l.f. SKIN Suntouchable! Invisible Sunscreen SPF 35. The formula feels lightweight and silky on the skin, blending in completely without leaving a white cast. It wears comfortably throughout the day and works beautifully under makeup as a smoothing primer. I also appreciate that it provides broad-spectrum sun protection while feeling virtually invisible. The packaging is convenient and travel-friendly, making it easy to reapply when needed. Overall, it's a great everyday sunscreen that offers protection without sacrificing comfort or appearance.
Feels like a film on the skin, there is not a good protection. The smell is bad, but it's good for winter season. Safe packing, easy to use . The texture is pleasant.
This is my new favorite face sunscreen. Goes on clear and not greasy. No complaints

avis.titre: Ready for safe fun in the sun ☀️
avis.texte: As we all know, one of the most important steps of skincare is SUNSCREEN and Elf did not miss with this one. Perfect for everyday wear, not greasy or thick on the skin. Apply super smooth too. And for that price? Would recommend!

I've been really impressed with the e.l.f. SKIN Suntouchable Invisible Sunscreen SPF 35. It's lightweight, smooth, and layers so well under makeup without pilling or feeling heavy. One of my favorite things is that it doesn't make my skin oily at all.

avis.titre: Perfect competitor for the number 1 yellow and whi
avis.texte: This is the perfect sunscreen for someone that wants something mess free, non greasy, lightweight silicone texture with an spf 30 on their hands and no white cast whatsoever! Also the best part is that it is a quarter of the price of its competitors and performs the same!

avis.titre: Lightweight, no white cast, no greasiness
avis.texte: I love the sunscreen 🥰 Spreads easily, for dry skin it feels comfortable without being heavy and should be genuinely invisible for all skin tones. It's also a good primer silky and blurring, plays well under makeup 💄

for the past 40 years, since I was maybe 25-30 I have tried many, many, many sunscreens specifically for the face. Every one (within my budget) was greasy,heavy, and always broke my face out in a spot or 2. So I typically do not use sunscreen on my face. Well I do now! I thought I'd give it a try and after using for 10 days, it's lightweight, makes my complexion look so smooth, no grease or oil and not one adverse reaction (breakout). I'm going to stock up just in case ELF discontinues this one. It's amazing for me.
I like it very mich. smoothes my pores and very comfortable to wear

no eye burn for me. it's a soft gel that easily blends into skin (mine is oily) without pilling. when i sweat i don't feel like it's doing anything different. knocked one star off for low spf otherwise it's great
I love this product because it's a perfect mix of a primer and spf. My make up went on so smoothly with it. It's definitely a dupe for the more expensive product.
This stays in my beach back. Glowy and sparkly. Fantastic sunscreen.
unfortunately I had a bad reaction, my face swelled up for 2 days. so even if it says sensitive skin friendly, it may not be. research it if you have very fussy skin like me.

This product is a great base for your makeup! Use it when you do pull glam or an everyday makeup look! Doesn't look extremely heavy or greasy! It helps your makeup stay and helps your makeup look last longer than any normal base! A little product goes a long way! Truly favorite product of the line! Professional quality and everyday staple! I love how it's invisible and doesn't leave a white cast on my face. Would buy a full-size soon.

It's very lightweight and it blends completely clear with no white cast and works well under makeup because it also acts like a primer. It's super easy to wear everyday and makes applying SPF feel effortless.

GET IT!! My skin looked FLAWLESS within seconds of applying. A nice smooth matte consistency that spreads easily and evenly. No scent and it's travel size so that's even better. I wear this even when I'm not in the sun!!
This sunscreen is very lightweight and truly feels invisible on the skin. It blends quickly and doesn't leave a white cast. I like it using it under makeup because it feels smooth.
Feels like a thick primer, use it, your pores wont show after your makeup, hides everything nice.

I've used several primers before and this one wins. It definitely gives your makeup a smoother look. I tried their glittery one and it's okay but it eventually looks cakey but this one does NOT have that effect. I work in a semi hot environment and my makeup still held up EXTREMELY well after using this primer. I have extremely dry and flaky skin and I use curology moisturizer before applying anything else. Then I use morphe's prep and set setting mist. I let it sit and dry then use this primer and it has improved my makeup texture SO MUCH. Of course there will always be some sort of texture because skin is not perfect but if you want it as smooth as possible then this is the primer you're looking for.

I have oily skin but this sunscreen blurs my pores and leaves me with a matte dewy look if that makes sense? It feels like a silicone primer and layers nicely with makeup. I wish they sold a larger size.

I love the Whoa glow product and was hoping this would be similar, without the glow, but it really didn't play well on top of the rest of my skincare routine (toner, serums, moisturizer). This is a great sunscreen! It's perfect for under makeup or on its own. It's truly invisible and doesn't leave a white cast or any greasiness behind. It leave my skin almost airbrushed looking and very moisturized. I just wish it has more spf but it's a great buy for the price

avis.titre: The best sunscreen ever for sensitive skin and doe

I hate the oily feeling of sunscreens and this overall still made my skin feel like clean skin not gross. I will definitely be purchasing this in the future.
This is really one of my favorite sunscreens. I love the texture and how it feels after applying it. And obviously, no white cast:)
This sunscreen is a very light finish. It helps protect the skin without leaving it feeling heavy. I have very sensitive skin and it did not irritate me at all.

Absolutely loved these products, always been a fan of E.L.F sunscreen was a perfect touch and out in the Florida sun, did not worry any unfortunate sin burns
I really like it; it protects my face from the sun and is a primer that creates a smooth, poreless look every time I do my makeup, and it's water-resistant.
Can write just say kudos for this invisible protection, zero white cast. Makes your skin fill light weight because it absorbs well. No harm ingredients. Elf is doing wonders with this sunscreen.

avis.titre: Fantastic product - will buy over and over

Loved how lightweight and hydrated this left me! It gave me protection but didn't leave me greasy or with a white cast. Definitely a dupe for supergoop!

I'm obsessed with this SPF primer! It's the perfect first step in my makeup routine. It feels amazing on the skin and creates a smooth, glowy base that helps my foundation lay perfectly. Love that I get sun protection and a primer all in one. Highly recommend!
Really loved this product! Went on skin well without leaving your skin greasy. Lasted all day! Was easy to remove and did not break me out or anything. I would buy!
This sunscreen offers an effective sunscreen barrier, it goes on smoothly, has an amazing pore blurring effect, and it doesn't make my sensitive eyes water.

avis.titre: Lightweight, invisible sunscreen that's perfect fo
avis.texte: This sunscreen is lightweight, truly invisible, and blends effortlessly into my skin without leaving a white cast. It feels smooth and comfortable, making it perfect for everyday wear under makeup or on its own. I love that it provides reliable sun protection while feeling more like a skincare product than sunscreen.
I repurchase over and over, this has a great texture as a primer with benefit of sunscreen. Highly recommend.

I try a lot of sunscreens, and this one stands out for me b/c it is completely invisible and the gel-cream texture (hydrating without being really greasy or heavy). The blurring primer is nice if I wear it alone, but if I'm wearing makeup, I usually apply another primer after this b/c my make up will still slide around a little. It is better at not bleeding into my eyes and irritating them than one of my other top chemical and invisible sunscreens, but it still happens some (longer days, warmer weather, etc), so a little powder around my eyes helps control this

I really wanted to love this sunscreen, as initially it felt great on my skin. It's a primer as well, so I thought it'd be good, since it felt velvety on my skin. However, it pills really bad, no matter what I do, so my makeup doesn't sit right
This product doesn't sting unless it gets it your eyes, feels great on the skin, very portable product, provides outstanding protection and makes your skin shine like the sun!

Love how smooth and cast free this is. Adds moisture and protects my skin all in one without leaving my skin oily So convenient that I keep one in the car and in my bag. My go-to for a makeup free day.
The elf skin untouchable sunscreen spf 35 is now a go to for me! Super moisturizing and didn't sting with applying, I have dry skin! Great coverage and absorbed quickly!

It did feel a little wet on my skin, but a setting powder probably would have fixed that. Overall I am impressed with this product and plan to use it as my go to face sunscreen.

ELF has truly stepped up their game. The entire sun touchable like is incredible. The glowy sunscreen looks stunning on skin and absorbs gorgeously. Major dupe for a more expensive version. Packaging is adorable!

I love this sunscreen. It isn't greasy and works well under foundation.
ELF sunscreen is lightweight, smooth, and affordable, blending easily into the skin while providing great protection and a natural glow. I would use this product again

I've been really impressed with the e.l.f. Suntouchable Invisible Sunscreen SPF 35. The texture is silky and blends effortlessly, leaving absolutely no white cast, which is rare for a sunscreen at this price point
I have been using this product for a while. My niece introduced me to it. Her skin is perfect! It's so smooth and it's not greasy and it doesn't leave a shine. I wear it daily under my makeup.
Setting spray and sunscreen all in one , how amazing. Ingredients are so nice nothing harsh and it absorbs really good , and protects your skin so what more can you ask for.
This sunscreen is great! It protects your face and it also is a primer ! It's also water resistant so you can wear in the water! It doesn't have a scent.
I really love this product. It goes on nicely and provides light coverage and sun protection. I used it even prior to being sent it for my review and will continue.

This suntouchable invisible sunscreen plus blurring primer is excellent at blurring imperfections. Goes on smooth and is water resistant for 80 minutes! Great for at the beach or in the heat. Check this out.

I also like that it's not heavily scented like most other sunscreens, the scent is very mild and easy to tolerate. Such a good product.

Keeps my make up from settling in fine lines. Make up easy to apply and blends easily use with elf setting spray and my makeup lasts all day

the only way i could ever be able is to get my own car to work for a month or so before the pandemic

avis.titre: I never leave the house without it.

Deducted some points because this comes out super thick and I don't like the way it sits on my face. Would not recommend for oily skin. His a light scent which I appreciate but would not use this on the daily.

I really like this sunscreen it works perfect for my skin. It's smooth and leaves your skin feel smooth afterwards. It doesn't leave white residue after. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.I definitely recommend it.

LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS. absolutely no white cast and leaves a clear, non greasy look. Perfect blurring effect. Why oh why don't don't they make larger size?? Black woman approved. Hot tip: Traders Joe's Facial sunscreen is a great dupe, but only $1 cheaper.

I love the smell and feel of this suntouchable. . It melts right into my skin. The vibrant yellow packaging is cute as well. Definitely feels like no sun can get through me.

I like this elf invisible sunscreen. It is an all in one sunscreen with spf 35 broad spectrum. It also acts as a primer. Which, can be used on its own or with your favorite foundation. It doesn't have a scent which is nice. It feel like butter without being greasy.

avis.titre: Great primer, sunscreen is just okay
avis.texte: This is a great primer, and I love it as a primer! The sunscreen is just okay. As a primer, it blurs my pores and it works really well with my oily skin, and it doesn't get in my eyes when I sweat (going out for a run outside). As a sunscreen, it isn't enough protection for me (I reapplied after about an hour but I still got pink from the sun). Maybe I should have reapplied after 30 minutes, or maybe I shouldn't expect so much from only SPF 35. Either way, I love it as a primer but as a sunscreen it is ehh just okay...full disclosure I am a natural redhead/ginger and I probably really need SPF 50.
I loved how light weight the sunscreen is! It has a very low fragrance to it and it also has a blurring primer added to it! This is definitely my go to summer moisturizer!!

I love the colors of the tubes . So vibrant and easy to find in your bag . The scent is not to strong and smells nice . It's not sticky and feels moisturizing . It lasted the day . I'd recommend and buy

This product is a silicone based blurring primer first and a "sunscreen" second. It definitely blurs my pores as advertised, leaving the skin feeling silky smooth and has no fragrance. I'm unsure about using it as my only form of sun protection, since it's only spf 35 and you'd require a lot of product to cover the face. Since it's silicone based I find that this can clog the pores and break me out if not double cleansed properly. Other than that, this is a nice product to use daily for a bare face look but it also provides a nice base for makeup in general.
Love this as a sunscreen on a bare skin day or as a primer under makeup. Will definitely be back for more!
Smells nice, texture is lovely and soft feeling. Pleasantly surprised.
Great texture. Layers great with my other base products before foundation. Leaves no white cast. Will definitely keep using.
Loved it. Easy to use and feels so smooth. The ingredients are minimal. Packaging was super cute and summery. Not a strong scent. I didn't get burnt at all.
I used this religiously now!! It is used as my moisturizer!! My face hasn't been as healthy as it is today in years. And my acne is cleared up! One of my favorite products

This is cool! This is my first time seeing a transparent sunscreen! It's like a gel-like texture, and it glides on my skin. I never have to worry about white-cast. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

absolutely love I get this every summer for when I go to the beach, keeps my skin hydrated and glowy. it is super light weight. The beach smell and cute packaging are perfect for it to take with you on beach trips

avis.titre: Almost perfect except that it broke me out...

this is a great product to use under makeup. it primes your face well and offers sun protection which is always a plus. i would definitely recommend this product.

avis.titre: I loved it, I recommend it
